subject.title: fix(ios): prevent black edge bands in chat

question: Should the iOS owner approve landing this visual regression fix after the current-head native iOS build and merge-result refresh complete?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and final native rendering behavior should be accepted by the owner rather than inferred solely from source inspection.

options.title: Approve after native validation

options.title: Request broader device evidence
options.body: Ask for physical-device or additional iOS-version proof only if the owner believes the simulator evidence does not cover the supported visual surface.
